criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 6 February 2027 (90 days before the 7 May 2027 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.
Calculates the service credit as $30,000 (25% of the $120,000 monthly fee for 97.4% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $6,000 is too low.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 6 February 2027, with days remaining from 20 November 2026 (78 days).
Notes that 6 February 2027 is a Saturday and that notice should be served by the preceding Business Day, 5 February 2027.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
